# Webservice image management doesn't handle WebP

Inside PrestaShop 8, webP format is enabled but the webservice doesn't manage it as you can see here: https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/classes/webservice/WebserviceSpecificManagementImages.php#L140

## Étapes
1. Add webP image
2. Get it with webservice

ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
